admin_login_intro: Enter your email and password to open your stores.
admin_login_failed: That email and password did not match.
admin_register_intro: You become its owner, with every permission. A main branch, a main store and the usual units (piece, box, kg, quintal, litre…) are set up for you.
admin_register_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
admin_register_failed: The account could not be created. Please try again.
admin_forgot_intro: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
admin_forgot_sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
admin_forgot_sent_help: It works for one hour. Check the spam folder if it is not in your inbox. No email? Your business owner can also set a new password for you from the Users screen.
admin_forgot_done: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
admin_reset_invalid: This reset link has expired or was already used.
admin_reset_invalid_ask: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
admin_reset_done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
admin_change_wrong_current: That is not your current password.
admin_change_failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.
admin_change_done: Password changed. Other devices signed in as you have been signed out.
admin_v_password_8: Password must be at least 8 characters
admin_v_signin_email: Enter the email you sign in with
admin_v_passwords_differ: The two passwords do not match
admin_v_not_same: Choose a password you are not already using
admin_mail_reset_body: Someone asked to reset the password for your stock management account. The link works for one hour and only once.
admin_mail_reset_footnote: If this was not you, ignore this email — your password stays as it is.
admin_mail_changed_body: The password for your stock management account has just been reset, and every device signed in as you was signed out.
admin_mail_changed_footnote: If you did not do this, contact your business owner straight away.
admin_home_unverified_hint: Transactions this month waiting for a check
admin_home_approvals_hint: Adjustments, counts and orders over your limits
admin_home_in_transit_hint: Sent to another branch, not yet received
admin_home_expired_hint: Cannot be issued; quarantine or write off
admin_home_no_stock_role: Welcome, {name}. Your role does not include viewing stock; use the menu for what it does include.
admin_home_expiry_desc: Lots with stock that have expired or will soon.
admin_home_reorder_desc: Items at or below their reorder level.
admin_home_no_docs_before: No documents yet. Start with a
admin_panel_intro: The lists the rest of the system picks from, and who may do what.
admin_v_branch_code: 2–10 letters or digits, e.g. ADD or BDR
admin_cat_warning_placeholder: How early a lot counts as expiring soon
admin_cat_min_shelf_placeholder: Empty: accept any. E.g. 180 for medicine
admin_branch_code_placeholder: e.g. ADD — starts every document number from this branch
admin_loc_transit_kept: That location is where transfers wait on the road; the system keeps it.
admin_pl_prices_intro: A customer on a list buys its items at the list's prices; anything not on it sells at the item's own price. Assign a list on the customer's page.
admin_pl_intro: Prices before VAT. A price for the base unit also prices its packs (a box of 10 at ten times it) unless the pack has its own price here.
admin_pl_choose_item: Choose an item from the list.
admin_pl_no_conversion: {item} has no conversion for this unit.
admin_fd_intro: The MoR-registered sales registers and fiscal printers that print your legal receipts. Optional: without one, nothing about fiscal receipts appears anywhere. Every field can be left empty and filled in later. Tax groups map rates to the device's groups (e.g. {groups}); secrets are stored encrypted — leave them empty when editing to keep them.
admin_fd_kind_manual: Manual — ring up on the device, type the FS No. here
admin_fd_kind_datecs: Datecs protocol over the network (FP-/DP- series)
admin_fd_kind_bridge: HTTP bridge (vendor service for USB/serial devices)
admin_fd_need_port: Give the port the device listens on.
admin_sms_test_logged: Logged in test mode — not sent
admin_sms_intro: Text messages to customers, suppliers and your own staff, through GeezSMS. Messages start with "{signature}:" and are at most 335 characters.
admin_sms_no_key: This server has no SMS account set up (SMS_KEY), so nothing can be sent yet.
admin_sms_dry_run: Test mode: messages are written to the log below but not sent (SMS_DRY_RUN is on for this server).
admin_sms_settings_desc: Nothing is sent until SMS is on.
admin_sms_enabled_desc: On: the messages below go out, and people with the right to may text customers and suppliers (reminders, proformas, orders).
admin_sms_sales_desc: A named customer with a mobile number gets the receipt number, total, what they paid and what they owe. At the till a receipt can also be texted to any number the customer gives.
admin_sms_payments_desc: When money from a customer is recorded: how much, and what they still owe.
admin_sms_alert_phones_desc: These numbers hear of approvals waiting, transfers on the way to a branch (the branch's own phone too, if it is a mobile), requisitions submitted, and a short morning digest.
admin_sms_test_desc: To your own phone, to see what arrives.
admin_v_mobiles: Ethiopian mobile numbers, separated by commas
admin_biz_intro: How your business appears in the menu and on every printed receipt, issue voucher and transfer note.
admin_biz_sells: We sell — keep a customer list (always optional on a sale)
admin_biz_internal: Internal store only — we issue to departments, never sell
admin_biz_customers_desc: The internal setting hides the customer list and every customer picker. Nothing recorded is lost; switch back at any time.
admin_biz_vat_no: Not VAT-registered — no VAT on sales
admin_biz_vat_desc: Applies to sales posted from now on; posted invoices keep the VAT they were posted with.
admin_biz_wh_yes: Withholding agent — keep back tax on large purchases
admin_biz_wh_desc: Payments for deliveries at or above the threshold suggest the tax to keep back (30% if the supplier has no TIN).
admin_biz_wh_threshold: From a purchase of (ETB, before VAT)
admin_biz_tot: Turnover tax (TOT) rate on goods (%, optional)
admin_biz_tot_desc: Only for a TOT payer that is not VAT-registered. Empty: no TOT. Items can set their own rate (services are often higher).
admin_biz_discount: Largest discount a seller may give (%, optional)
admin_biz_discount_desc: At the till and on proformas. Bigger discounts need the 'give discounts above the limit' permission. Empty: no limit.
admin_biz_einv_sandbox: Sandbox — try the flow; nothing is sent
admin_biz_einv_live: Live — send every sale to the endpoint below
admin_biz_einv_desc: Optional. Invoices are sent after a sale is posted; a failure never blocks the sale and can be retried.
admin_biz_einv_token_desc: For OAuth client-credentials sign-in. Empty: the client ID and secret are sent as Basic auth.
admin_biz_einv_secret_stored: Stored — leave empty to keep it
admin_biz_costing_avg: Moving average — every unit of an item costs the same
admin_biz_costing_fifo: FIFO — the oldest purchases are used up first
admin_biz_costing_desc: How stock that leaves (sold, written off, returned) is valued. Switching to FIFO starts from what is on hand at today's average cost; switching back carries on from FIFO's figures. Posted documents keep their values.
admin_biz_res_off: Off — stock is first come, first served
admin_biz_res_on: Hold stock for accepted proformas and approved requisitions
admin_biz_res_desc: When on, the till and other issues cannot take what is held for someone else. It is released when their sale or issue is posted, or the proforma is cancelled or runs out.
admin_biz_approvals_intro: Approvals (maker-checker): anything at or over these amounts, at cost, waits for someone else with the right to approve. Leave empty for no approval.
admin_biz_wo_limit: Only over the adjustment limit above
admin_biz_wo_always: Always need approval, whatever the value
admin_biz_wo_desc: A write-off is any adjustment that takes stock out: damage, expiry, loss.
admin_biz_counts_over: Stock counts whose differences come to (ETB, optional)
admin_biz_logo_desc: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. A square or wide image works best.
admin_biz_no_logo: No logo yet — the business name is shown instead.
admin_biz_saved_fifo: Saved. Stock is now costed first in, first out, starting from today’s average cost
admin_biz_logo_type: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image
admin_v_logo_2mb: A logo can be at most 2 MB.
admin_v_logo_type: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
admin_perm_settings_manage: Maintain branches, locations, categories and units
admin_perm_business_manage: Change the business name, TIN, contact details and logo
admin_perm_suppliers_view: See suppliers, what they delivered, and what is owed to them
admin_perm_suppliers_manage: Add suppliers and change their details
admin_perm_customers_view: See customers, what they took and what they paid
admin_perm_customers_manage: Add customers and change their details, including credit limits
admin_perm_customers_credit: Post a sale that takes a customer over their credit limit
admin_perm_pos_use: Sell at the till (POS): open a shift, ring up sales, take payments
admin_perm_pos_manage: See every till shift, and close someone else's
admin_perm_sales_manage: Write proformas, send them, and turn them into sales
admin_perm_sales_discount: Give discounts above the limit, and change prices freely
admin_perm_purchasing_view: See purchase orders and what needs reordering
admin_perm_purchasing_manage: Draft purchase orders, send them to suppliers, close and cancel them
admin_perm_reports_view: Read the stock, purchase, wastage and money reports, and export them
admin_perm_roles_manage: Create roles and decide what they may do
admin_perm_items_manage: Add and change items, their units and barcodes
admin_perm_stock_view: See stock on hand, lots, and stock documents
admin_perm_stock_draft: Prepare receipts, issues, transfers and adjustments
admin_perm_stock_post: Post stock documents, which changes stock, or cancel drafts
admin_perm_transactions_view: See every transaction, with totals of money in and out
admin_perm_transactions_manage: Record payments and receipts, attach screenshots and PDFs, void mistakes
admin_perm_transactions_verify: Mark a transaction verified after checking the bank or Telebirr statement
admin_perm_branches_all: Work in every branch, whatever branches the user is assigned (without it, assigned branches only)
admin_perm_requisitions_view: See requisitions: what departments asked the store for
admin_perm_requisitions_request: Write and submit requisitions for a department's needs
admin_perm_requisitions_approve: Approve (or cut, or reject) requisitions, and issue what was approved
admin_perm_approvals_view: See what is waiting for approval, and what was decided
admin_perm_approvals_decide: Approve or reject large adjustments, write-offs, count differences and purchase orders
admin_perm_data_import: Import items, suppliers, customers and opening stock from a spreadsheet
admin_perm_sms_send: Text customers and suppliers: credit reminders, proformas, purchase orders and notes
admin_users_add_desc: They sign in with this email and password.
admin_users_home_branch_desc: Where they usually work: the default on their forms.
admin_users_works_in_desc: Tick the branches whose stock they may see and move. None ticked: every branch. Owners and managers (who may work in every branch) see everything anyway.
admin_users_reset_desc: {name} is signed out everywhere and signs in again with this password.
admin_users_delete_consequence: They are signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. What they recorded stays, under their name.
admin_users_saving_signs_out: Saving signs {name} out of every device, so the change applies straight away.
admin_users_own_perms_placeholder: Give this user their own permissions instead of the role’s
admin_users_choose_role: Choose a role from the list.
admin_users_only_owner_add_owner: Only an owner can add another owner.
admin_users_choose_branch: Choose a branch from the list.
admin_users_email_in_use: That email is already in use.
admin_users_email_taken_other: Another account already uses this email.
admin_users_only_owner_change_owner: Only an owner can change an owner, or make someone an owner.
admin_users_only_active_owner: This is the only active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
admin_users_cannot_grant: You cannot grant permissions you do not hold: {names}
admin_users_only_owner_reset_owner: Only an owner can reset an owner’s password.
admin_users_password_changed: Password changed. Tell {name} the new one; they have been signed out.
admin_users_cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
admin_users_only_active_owner_short: This is the only active owner.
admin_users_removed: {name} was removed and signed out everywhere.
admin_roles_delete_consequence: Its permission grants go with it.
admin_roles_owner_note: The owner role holds every permission, including new ones as they are added, and cannot be edited or deleted.
admin_roles_owner_fixed: The owner role always holds every permission and cannot be changed.
admin_roles_name_exists: A role with this name already exists.
admin_roles_owner_no_delete: The owner role cannot be deleted.
admin_roles_still_used: {count} user(s) still on this role. Move them to another role first.
admin_opt_choose_branch: Choose a branch from the list.
admin_opt_choose_category: Choose a category from the list.
admin_opt_choose_supplier: Choose a supplier from the list.
admin_opt_choose_unit: Choose a unit from the list.
admin_opt_choose_customer: Choose a customer from the list.
admin_opt_choose_item: Choose a item from the list.
admin_opt_choose_location: Choose a location from the list.
admin_tenant_no_business: Your account is not attached to a business.
admin_imp_note_unit_new: Unit name or symbol; made if new
admin_imp_too_big: The file is over 5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
admin_imp_bad_excel: That Excel file could not be read. Save it again as .xlsx or .csv.
admin_imp_no_columns: None of the columns are recognised. Start from the {kind} template: its first row names the columns.
admin_imp_no_data: The file has a header row but no data under it.
admin_imp_too_many_rows: The file has {rows} rows; import at most {max} at a time.
admin_imp_date: {label}: write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, not “{value}”.
admin_imp_no_customers: This business does not sell to customers (Business profile). Turn that on to import customers.
admin_imp_barcode_taken: Barcode {code} is already on another item.
admin_imp_unit_empty: Unit is empty: say what it is counted in.
admin_imp_unit_new: Unit “{unit}” is new and will be added.
admin_imp_category_new: Category “{category}” is new and will be added.
admin_imp_vat_word: VAT: write standard, zero or exempt, not “{value}”.
admin_imp_supplier_unknown: Supplier “{name}” is not on the list. Import suppliers first.
admin_imp_supplier_needed: Main supplier is empty; every stocked item needs one.
admin_imp_moved: Stock of this item has moved, so its unit and lot/expiry/serial tracking cannot change.
admin_imp_pack_unit_empty: Pack unit is empty but a pack factor or barcode is given.
admin_imp_pack_same: Pack unit is the same as the base unit.
admin_imp_pack_kept: The item already has {unit} at {factor}; that is kept.
admin_imp_phone_empty: Phone is empty; a supplier is reached by phone.
admin_imp_no_item: No item has SKU {sku}. Import items first.
admin_imp_location_ambiguous: More than one branch has “{location}”: write "Branch · {location}".
admin_imp_already_there: {quantity} is already there; this adds to it.
admin_imp_needs_expiry: {item} tracks expiry: give the expiry date.
admin_imp_serial_count: {item} tracks serials: list exactly {quantity} serial number(s).
admin_imp_serial_base: Serial-tracked stock is imported in its base unit.
admin_imp_nothing_imported_rows: Nothing was imported: {count} row(s) have problems. Row {row}: {error}
admin_imp_preview_lost: The preview could not be read back. Preview the file again.
admin_imp_intro: Bring in what you already keep in Excel. Import suppliers first, then items (they name their main supplier), then opening stock (it names items by SKU). Nothing is written until you have seen the preview, and a file with any bad row imports nothing at all.
admin_imp_step1_desc: A .csv or .xlsx file whose first row names the columns, up to {max} rows. Start from the template: column names are matched loosely, and columns you do not need may be left out.
admin_imp_fix_rows: Fix the rows marked “Fix first” in your spreadsheet and preview it again. Nothing is imported while any row has a problem.
